samples.xml_description:
<module id="synchronizer">
    <description>Implement a multi-bit MUX-based synchronizer. The input data will remain constant during the period when data_en is high, and data_en is high for at least 3 clk_b clock cycles. When the value of data_en is high, data can be synchronized. The data change frequency of data_in is very low. The change interval between two adjacent data is at least 10 clk_b clock cycles. clk_a is responsible for data_in and data_en, while clk_b is responsible for the enable signal delays and output dataout.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk_a">Clock signal A.</input>
        <input id="clk_b">Clock signal B.</input>
        <input id="arstn">Active-low reset signal A.</input>
        <input id="brstn">Active-low reset signal B.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[3:0]">Input data signal.</input>
        <input id="data_en">Input enable signal.</input>
        <output id="dataout" width_description="[3:0]">Output data signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="data_reg">Data register to store input data.</parameter>
        <parameter id="en_data_reg">Enable data register to store input enable signal.</parameter>
        <parameter id="en_clap_one">Enable control register 1 to control data selection.</parameter>
        <parameter id="en_clap_two">Enable control register 2 to control data selection.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <sequential_logic id="data_reg">Stores input data and is updated on the positive edge of clk_a or the negative edge of arstn. If arstn is low, data_reg is reset to 0. Otherwise, data_reg is updated with data_in.</sequential_logic>
        <sequential_logic id="en_data_reg">Stores input enable signal and is updated on the positive edge of clk_a or the negative edge of arstn. If arstn is low, en_data_reg is reset to 0. Otherwise, en_data_reg is updated with data_en.</sequential_logic>
        <sequential_logic id="en_clap_one">Stores the value of en_data_reg and is updated on the positive edge of clk_b or the negative edge of brstn. If brstn is low, en_clap_one is reset to 0. Otherwise, en_clap_one is updated with en_data_reg.</sequential_logic>
        <sequential_logic id="en_clap_two">Stores the value of en_clap_one and is updated on the positive edge of clk_b or the negative edge of brstn. If brstn is low, en_clap_two is reset to 0. Otherwise, en_clap_two is updated with en_clap_one.</sequential_logic>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implement a multi-bit MUX-based synchronizer. The input data will remain constant during the period when data_en is high, and data_en is high for at least 3 clk_b clock cycles. When the value of data_en is high, data can be synchronized. The data change frequency of data_in is very low. The change interval between two adjacent data is at least 10 clk_b clock cycles. clk_a is responsible for data_in and data_en, while clk_b is responsible for the enable signal delays and output dataout.</implementation>
</module>
